$comment: The faculty/content registry -- answers 'what does this tenant teach', nothing about bot processes/tokens (that's telegram/config/bots.json, added 2026-08-10 -- see bots.README.md). Adding a faculty entry here with content_scope filled in is meant to be the ENTIRE onboarding step for shared-1LAVYA-content access -- no bot code should need to change. own_content additions are separate, deliberately slower work (see own_content.status below) -- never conflate the two.

Flagship MCQ/descriptive practice bot, unrestricted scope.
